gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-newa: Toothpaste-line letters, squeezed out in one steady stroke, lead the way. Noto Sans Newa below has a clearly open e and tall bowls, so paragraphs go down easily.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-ol-chiki: Amatic SC writes quirky, rustic letters with ends as wide as the middle, terminals stopping far from the stem. Noto Sans Ol Chiki holds back with tidy, solid word blocks.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-old-hungarian: Strokes pulled like solder through a nozzle give Amatic SC its rustic, quirky, hand-drawn look, terminals stopping far from the stem. Noto Sans Old Hungarian stays open down to tiny sizes.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-old-italic: Quirky and rustic, Amatic SC runs its stems and connecting strokes with no modulation at all. Noto Sans Old Italic sits tight, its x-height nearly touching cap height.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-old-permic: A plain, unshaded line that never swells defines Amatic SC, rustic and quirky. Noto Sans Old Permic keeps rounded forms open to the side, so a full page of text goes down smoothly.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Amatic SC looks traced with one marker, rustic and quirky, its stroke steady from start to finish. Noto Sans Oriya keeps its curve gaps generous, so text runs along comfortably.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: A constant-width line, like a marker, gives Amatic SC its rustic, quirky look, with terminals stopping far from the stem. Noto Sans Osmanya reads smoothly, with wide, easy s turns.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-hmong: Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong has rounds that gap like a cracked bangle. Beside Amatic SC, with its rustic, quirky strokes of unvarying thickness, it feels crisp and distinctly contemporary.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-saurashtra: With capitals that barely stand taller than their neighbors, Noto Sans Saurashtra keeps its counters connected to the outside. And Amatic SC, with every stroke at a single thickness, brings the rustic, quirky side.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Quirky and rustic, Amatic SC is a monoline hand. It earns its keep big and short, while Noto Sans Siddham handles the text with a large central band and an s with far-hanging ends.
